'''Borolol's Claw''' was a mountain on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. It was the only place on the moon where the constant storms could be breached by a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents rescued political prisoners from the moon by scaling Borolol's Claw and escaping aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
